test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find a single discount (rounded up to two decimal places) equal to three consecutive discounts of 26%, 29% and 2%.
solution:
**Given:**

Discounts = 26%, 29%, 2%

**Formula used:**

Net multiplier = (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × (1 − d₃)

Single discount = (1 − net multiplier) × 100%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Net = 0.74 × 0.71 × 0.98

⇒ 0.74 × 0.71 = 0.5254

⇒ 0.5254 × 0.98 = 0.5254 − 0.010508 = 0.514892

⇒ Single discount = (1 − 0.514892) × 100% = 0.485108 × 100% = 48.5108%

⇒ Rounded = 48.51%

**∴ Equivalent single discount = 48.51%**
